hook.head: Claude can build you a working tool.
hook.vo: Most people only chat with Claude. But it can build you a working tool.

tips.vo: Ask for a price calculator for your services. Claude builds it right in the chat, and you can use it straight away.
tips.head: Price calculators.

msgs: Make a price calculator for my car wash
Done. Pick the car size and the package, and it shows the total.

tips.vo: Need to track orders? Ask for a simple tracker. Tell Claude which columns you need, and it builds the whole layout.
tips.head: Order trackers.

tips.vo: When you like it, publish it, and share the link with your team or your customers.
tips.head: Share the link.

msgs: Can my team use this too?
Yes. Publish it and send them the link.
